name: TRUTH App — Protected Table Snapshot to Drive
description: Polls snapshot queue every 10 min. Saves change records from protected tables to Drive as .md files. Guards drift_guards, framework_rules, tensions_wall, kb_sights, kb_conclusions.

parameters.jsCode:
const built = $('Build Snapshot Content').all().map(x => x.json);
return [{ json: { status: 'snapshot_saved', tables: built.map(b => b.table_name), files: built.map(b => b.filename), saved: $input.all().length, ts: new Date().toISOString() } }];
